show.description: "Ziddi Aashiq" follows Ashray, a poor street cricketer, and Anjali, a wealthy mute girl, whose romance is destroyed when her arrogant father and a cruel suitor, Balwant, force her into an abusive marriage. After a dark spiral into alcoholism, Ashray claws his way onto the Indian national cricket team. He ultimately confronts Balwant to rescue Anjali, wins a high-stakes international match, and reunites with her to build a new life.
